title: Engineering & Technology Studentship
about: The European Southern Observatory (ESO) invites applications for an Engineering & Technology Studentship based in Garching, Germany, starting in Q3 2027. Applications in English, with cover letter, CV and two-page research plan, are due 31 December 2026.
requirements: Nationals of, or students in, an ESO Member State or Chile
Master's degree qualifying for a doctoral school
